items.title: Ampleness is preserved by base change
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the pullback of an invertible sheaf which is ample for a morphism remains ample for the base change of that morphism. The proof uses the criterion that ampleness may be checked after an affine open covering of the base, chooses the covering subordinate to affine opens of the original base, notes that the morphism between the corresponding preimages is affine as a base change of an affine morphism, and then applies the lemma on pulling back ample sheaves along an affine morphism.
